q: Can several small projects be grouped into one CCTS offset project?
title: Grouping small CCTS offset projects
short: Yes. BEE's project standard lets a developer combine several activities into one offset project, described in a single project design document. All of them must use similar technology, share the same crediting period and stay the same over time, and the PDD gives each site's location.
audience: Aggregators, cluster associations and ESCOs working with many small units

ul: One PDD that explains why the activities are grouped.
Similar technology, measures and other relevant attributes across all of them.
The composition does not change over time, and all share one crediting period.

p: The accredited agency files one registration request for the bundle. The registration fee is set by the total expected average annual reductions of all activities in the bundle, and BEE gives the bundle one reference number.
BEE has also invited comments on a draft procedure for programmes of activities, which lets units join over time. Check whether it has been finalised before you rely on it.

senseible: Senseible can hold invoice records for many units under one workspace, so the fuel and power data for each site in a bundle sits in one place.
